text: Fixed: Interval.fromISO now catches the throw from DateTime.fromISO when Settings.throwOnInvalid is true, so both "date/duration" and "duration/date" forms return a valid Interval. Verified against your two examples.
Fixed: objToLocalTS no longer resolves day/month overflow with the wrong leap-year rules for years 0-99. DateTime.fromISO("0099-12-31").plus({day:61}).toISODate() now gives "0100-03-02".
isInDST for 1974 is being reworked so that 1974-01-06 in America/Los_Angeles reports true. Verifying now.
Duration.normalize() NaN: the conversion matrices in src/duration.js were missing the years->quarters and quarters->seconds entries. Fix applied; verifying.
Negative-year ISO padding: the year token was zero-padding the minus sign. Fix applied; verifying.
FixedOffsetZone with a non-numeric offset: making it report isValid=false so DateTimes built with it are invalid ("unsupported zone"). Fix applied; verifying.
